info.title: tps — Roslyn-only C# → JavaScript translator (experimental
info.description: Transpose — Roslyn-based C# to JavaScript compiler.

options.name: --configuration
options.description:
Build configuration (Debug/Release; default Debug). Release
selects the .min.js resource variants where both exist.

options.name: --emit-package
options.description:
Compile this project as a distributable assembly: emit its
.NET DLL with the compiled JS + tps.json resources embedded
(Transpose.Resources.json manifest), for referencing by other projects.
--separate-assemblies Consume referenced projects as their built DLLs (extract their
embedded JS) instead of recompiling their source into the bundle.

options.name: --site-dir
options.description: Output directory for the assembled site

options.name: --with-runtime
options.description: Prepend the tps.js runtime + shim to the output
